content.text:
This is the as-found single-line diagram of a building's 480 V switchgear. Breakers 52-M2 and CB-09 both trip at the same moment. Nothing else changes: no other breaker opens or closes, N.O. ties stay open, and Generator G1 keeps running. Which loads that were running before the event lose power? A load behind an open breaker was not running. Answer with the load tags (for example CH-2), in the order they appear on the drawing from left to right, separated by commas.

Think step by step. Then end your reply with one final line in exactly this form:
FINAL ANSWER: <your answer>

message.content:
CB-04 remains closed and feeds BUS 2B from BUS 1; closed CB-06 also connects BUS 2B to BUS 2, so the loads on those buses retain power after 52-M2 trips. CB-09 isolates BUS EB from the generator-fed BUS E, and the alternate feed through normally open CB-02 remains unavailable. RP-3 was running through closed CB-20; PP-2 was not running because CB-21 was open.

FINAL ANSWER: RP-3
